item.title: Mixing Typography Volume One.
item.description:
Good day to all. I’m brand new to this forum and still checking it out. I’ve had a love of typography for ages and this year decided to get more pro-active about doing typography myself. So, here I am, to see and be seen (as it were).

And, since I’m new (in good old fashioned style) the first round is on me. Here’s a nifty wallpaper I made called Mixing Typography Volume One. (2560X1600). It was inspired by the Periodic Table of typefaces.
